body: 14 Nov 2026, DESIGN for the remaining part (advisor-approved; whoever takes it: a helper, app code). Owner's wording 13 Nov: when a playlist or even one song of an artist is downloaded he wants ALL its album covers and the artist's picture downloaded too, each ONCE (an artist with five songs on one album = one album cover + one artist picture), and offline nothing is a letter. WHAT EXISTS: CoverPrefetcher (data/covers/cover_prefetcher.dart, wired in app/cover_wiring.dart) fetches cover ids chosen by LibraryRepository.coverIdsToKeepOffline (rank 2 = songs on the phone, limit 600 on Wi-Fi, 120 small-only on mobile) into coverCacheManager (features/common/cover_art.dart: flutter_cache_manager, 'encoreCovers2', stale 365 days, maxNrOfCacheObjects 8000, stored in the TEMP directory). GAPS: (1) nothing is PINNED: the cache is LRU (browsing a library of a few thousand songs can push a downloaded song's cover out) and lives in the temp dir, so Android's 'Clear cache' (or the OS) erases every offline cover while the songs stay downloaded; (2) the artist picture of a downloaded song is not part of the 'kept offline' list; (3) the 600 limit can cut off downloaded songs' covers on a big library. PLAN: a second, PERSISTENT cache manager for pinned pictures (own directory under getApplicationSupportDirectory, no cleanup: maxNrOfCacheObjects very large, stale 10 years, a small custom FileSystem), consulted FIRST by coverCacheManager (make coverCacheManager a thin subclass of CacheManager that overrides getFileFromCache/getFileStream to look in the pinned one first, so CachedNetworkImage and _CachedOtherSize keep working unchanged); pinned entries are KEYED BY COVER ID / ARTIST ID AND SIZE (CoverSize.key), NEVER BY TRACK ID (so the later N-11 phone-side ref merge does not have to touch them); the prefetcher pins, for every DOWNLOADED song (downloads.state = done): its own cover id, its album's cover id and its artist's picture id, ONCE per id (a set), with no limit; unpin (delete) a picture only when no downloaded song needs it any more (run after a download is removed, in the same place the audio is deleted: download_planner/download_manager); mobile data: pin the small size only unless the person is on Wi-Fi (the Data saver switch P4-24 will cap it). TESTS: with fake file service: five songs of one album + one artist = 1 album cover + 1 artist picture fetched; a pinned picture survives the LRU cleanup and a simulated 'clear cache' of the normal one; unpin when the last song goes; offline the CoverArt widget shows the pinned file. Keep N-15 (the SERVER finding artist pictures Navidrome lacks) SEPARATE.
